count(

  | json depName, manager, currentValue, updateType
  | label_format run=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap run [12h]))
== on (repository) group_left ()
max by (repository) (max_over_time({service_name="renovate", kind="dependency", repository=~"$repository", manager=~"$manager"} | label_format run=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap run [12h]))

spec.description:
Every enabled dependency at each repository's latest run: one row per repository, dependency, manager and version.

- `Update`: the largest pending update; `Available` lists the new versions.
- `First seen`: the first run that reported this `Available` version, at most 30 days back.
- `Pending`: age of the oldest `Available` version, a lower bound on how long the update has waited.
- `Release gap`: from the release of `Current` to the release of the newest `Available`, mostly how often upstream releases.
- `Pending`, `Release gap`: empty where the registry publishes no release dates.
- `Status`: `lookup failed` is usually a registry Renovate has no credentials or route for; `skipped` cannot be updated by design, e.g. `latest` or a preset.

spec.expr:
max by (key, repository, depName, manager, currentValue, available, updateType, pendingDays, behindDays, status, reason, sourceUrl, rank) (max_over_time({service_name="renovate", kind="dependency", repository=~"$repository", manager=~"$manager"}
  | json depName, manager, currentValue, newVersion, updateType, pendingDays, behindDays, sourceUrl, skipReason, warning
  | label_format key=`{{ .repository }} {{ .depName }} {{ .manager }} {{ .currentValue }} {{ .newVersion }} {{ .updateType }}`
  | label_format available=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^(, )+|(, )+$" (regexReplaceAll "(, )+" .newVersion ", ") "" }}`, updateType=`{{ if contains "major" .updateType }}major{{ else if contains "minor" .updateType }}minor{{ else if contains "patch" .updateType }}patch{{ else }}{{ .updateType }}{{ end }}`
  | label_format status=`{{ if .warning }}lookup failed{{ else if .skipReason }}skipped{{ else if .updateType }}outdated{{ else }}current{{ end }}`, reason=`{{ if .warning }}{{ regexReplaceAll "^Failed to look up [^ ]+ package [^ ]+: " .warning "" }}{{ else }}{{ .skipReason }}{{ end }}`
  | label_format rank=`{{ if eq .status "outdated" }}3{{ else if eq .status "lookup failed" }}2{{ else if eq .status "current" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}`
  | label_format run=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap run [$__range]))
== on (repository) group_left ()
max by (repository) (max_over_time({service_name="renovate", kind="dependency", repository=~"$repository", manager=~"$manager"} | label_format run=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap run [$__range]))

min by (key) (min_over_time({service_name="renovate", kind="dependency", repository=~"$repository", manager=~"$manager"}
  | json depName, currentValue, newVersion, updateType
  | updateType != ""
  | label_format key=`{{ .repository }} {{ .depName }} {{ .manager }} {{ .currentValue }} {{ .newVersion }} {{ .updateType }}`
  | label_format first=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}`
  | unwrap first [30d])) * 1000
